ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is circle O, with O as the center of the circle. The points on the circumference, in the order from the lower right through the top to the left, can be regarded as C, B, D, E, F, and additionally A is at the lower left. Segment AB passes through the center O, and segment EC also passes through the center O, so they appear in the figure as two diameters. The required arc CBF is the arc from C to F that passes through B, so it is composed of arcs CB, BD, DE, EF. Reasoning: Let the equal central angles ∠BOD, ∠DOE, ∠EOF, ∠FOA all be x. Because AB is a diameter, the semicircle from OB to OA through D, E, F has a total of 180°, and is divided into four equal central angles, so 4x=180°, giving x=45°. Also because AB and EC are both diameters, OB and OA are opposite rays, and OE and OC are opposite rays, therefore ∠BOC and ∠AOE are vertical angles and are equal. ∠AOE=∠AOF+∠FOE=45°+45°=90°, so the measure of arc CB is 90°. Thus m arc CBF = m arc CB + m arc BD + m arc DE + m arc EF = 90° + 45° + 45° + 45° = 225°.

raw_record.question_text: In $\odot O$, $\overline{EC}$ and $\overline{AB}$ are diameters, and $\angle BOD \cong \angle DOE \cong \angle EOF \cong \angle FOA$. Find $m\widehat{CBF}$.

method.method_draft: 先从图像读出：圆心为 O，圆周点按所需弧线方向可看作 C、B、D、E、F 依次相邻，且 AB 与 EC 都穿过 O；要求的 \widehat{CBF} 是从 C 到 F 且经过 B 的那条弧，即由弧 CB、BD、DE、EF 组成。再用文字条件：EC 和 AB 是直径，所以 OB 与 OA 是反向射线，OE 与 OC 是反向射线；且 \angle BOD, \angle DOE, \angle EOF, \angle FOA 四个圆心角相等。令每个相等圆心角为 x。因为从 OB 到 OA 经过 D、E、F 的半圆被分成四个相等角，所以 4x=180°，x=45°。又因为 AB 与 EC 是两条直径，\angle BOC 与 \angle AOE 是对顶角，而 \angle AOE=\angle AOF+\angle FOE=45°+45°=90°，所以弧 CB 为 90°。于是 m\widehat{CBF}=m\widehat{CB}+m\widehat{BD}+m\widehat{DE}+m\widehat{EF}=90°+45°+45°+45°=225°。
